headline: Meta is making a standalone Muse AI gadget
summary: Meta is developing a dedicated hardware device for its Muse AI agent. The product, named Muse Charm, was briefly unveiled by Mark Zuckerberg. It appears to be a chunky smartwatch-like gadget with a big screen and lanyard.

headline: Meta Connect 2026: The 7 biggest announcements
summary: Meta showcased a range of new wearables at its Meta Connect event. The highlight was new Meta VR Glasses, lightweight smart glasses with a tethered puck. Other announcements included screen-free smart glasses and new AI features.

headline: Meta’s next VR device isn’t a headset — it’s glasses
summary: Meta is introducing innovative new VR hardware: a pair of glasses. These Meta VR Glasses sit on the ears like regular spectacles, unlike traditional headsets. They feature immersive displays for movies, games, and productivity.

headline: Muse is coming to Meta smart glasses
summary: Meta announced plans to integrate its Muse AI agent into smart glasses. Users will be able to activate Muse via voice commands from their glasses. Muse will assist with tasks such as guiding workouts and logging activities.

headline: Meta’s New VR Glasses to Entice Casual Viewers With 3D and Full-Frame IMAX
summary: Meta revealed its new VR Glasses, targeting casual viewers. The glasses aim to entice users with full 3D capabilities. They offer an immersive full-frame IMAX experience.

headline: Warner Bros. Pushes Back DC's Dynamic Duo Film, Gremlins 3 Gets One Year Delay
summary: Warner Bros. has revised its film release schedule. The DC's Dynamic Duo film has been pushed back. Gremlins 3 is now delayed by a full year.

headline: YouTube's New A/B Video Test Feature Is Already Creating Fears Over Weaponized Negativity
summary: YouTube is rolling out a new A/B testing feature for creators. This allows creators to test different versions of their videos. Concerns are rising about potential misuse leading to 'weaponized negativity.'

headline: Artist Behind Pokémon 30th Anniversary Jirachi SIR Card Gives Tearful Response to Late Influencer's Heart-Wrenching Final Pack Opening
summary: The artist of a rare Jirachi Pokémon card reacted emotionally to a video. Late influencer Avery the Poké Kid pulled the card in his final pack opening. Avery passed away from pancreatic cancer shortly after.

headline: Blood tests find high level of cancer-causing forever chemical in residents near factory
summary: Blood tests revealed high levels of a cancer-causing 'forever chemical' in Lancashire residents. The chemical exposure is linked to a nearby factory. Residents are being informed of potential serious health risks.

headline: What video footage tells us about RAF training jet crash
summary: An investigation is underway following an RAF Hawk training jet crash. The RAF has temporarily paused all Hawk jet training operations. Video footage is being analyzed to determine the cause of the incident.

headline: Trump offers warm welcome as China's Xi arrives for US visit
summary: President Trump extended a warm welcome to China's President Xi Jinping for his US visit. The visit aims to foster ongoing diplomatic relations between the two nations. The US and China reportedly agreed to extend a trade truce.

headline: A red carpet and military flyover - How Trump welcomed Xi
summary: President Trump hosted an elaborate welcome for China's Xi Jinping. The reception included a red carpet ceremony and a military flyover. B-1 bombers, known for their powerful roar, were part of the aerial display.
